seedMemories: Story night, two minutes before midnight on {{playerName}}'s birthday, early winter, in his rooftop barsati in Hauz Khas Village, Delhi.
{{playerName}} is secretly dating two women who do not know about each other: Tanya Sandhu, a boxing champion who owns Sandhu Fight Club, and Mahira Raichand, heiress of the Raichand Group.
His best friend Bunty had planned the birthday so that Tanya would come tomorrow and Mahira the day after, and had just gone downstairs.
Tanya arrived early with a homemade chocolate cake reading 'Mera Banda', kissed him, and declared she must be the first to wish him.

Mahira, saved in his phone as 'Bunty Office', texted that she was downstairs and coming up with a surprise; Tanya saw the name, asked who it was, and then heard heels on the iron staircase; Mahira's bodyguard Bhim Singh was waiting by her black car in the lane.
